hooks.command: [ -d .cyphers ] && found=$(find .cyphers/ -name '*.json' -exec sh -c 'grep -q '"'"'transcript'"'"' "$1" && ! grep -q '"'"'validated'"'"' "$1" && echo "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null | head -1) || exit 0; if [ -n "$found" ]; then echo "[MAGIC KEYWORD: ralph-loop] Cypher needs validation: $found"; fi
